title: Gluten-Free Focaccia
description: A bubbly, olive-oil-soaked focaccia with a crisp golden bottom, held together with a little psyllium so it actually tears and chews like the real thing. Top with rosemary and flaky salt.
swaps: Honey can be swapped for maple syrup if preferred.
watch: Tested with King Arthur Measure for Measure GF flour; confirm your blend is almond-free.

title: Rosemary Buckwheat Focaccia (Gluten-Free + Egg-Free)
description: An earthy, whole-grain focaccia made from raw buckwheat, brown rice and tapioca flours with a generous fistful of fresh rosemary. Hearty enough to dunk in soup or split for sandwiches.
watch: Use raw (light) buckwheat flour, not toasted kasha flour; check psyllium is pure husk powder.

title: Gluten Free Pizza Dough (Sorghum & Psyllium)
description: A whole-grain pizza dough built on sorghum and chickpea flour with psyllium for stretch, no store-bought blend needed. Makes four personal pies with a crisp, chewy edge.
swaps: Use maple syrup instead of honey if you prefer.
watch: Uses chickpea (garbanzo) flour; buy certified GF sorghum flour and psyllium husks.

title: Gluten Free Garlic Knots
description: Soft, pumpkin-tinted knots made from millet and oat flours, tied up and brushed with garlicky melted butter and parsley. A great side for pasta night.
swaps: Swap almond milk for oat or soy milk. Use a nut-free vegan butter (Earth Balance, Country Crock Plant Butter avocado/olive); avoid cashew-based Miyoko's.
watch: Oat flour must be certified gluten-free. Uses xanthan gum and ground flax.

title: Gluten-Free Vegan Pita Bread
description: Soft, foldable yeast pitas made from rice flours and starches with a psyllium gel for bend. Stuff them with falafel or tear them into hummus.
watch: Uses white and superfine brown rice flour, potato starch, arrowroot and xanthan gum (no pre-mixed blend).

title: Vegan Pão de Queijo (Brazilian Cheese Breads)
description: Crisp-shelled, stretchy tapioca puffs that get their savoury, cheesy flavour from mashed potato and nutritional yeast. Best eaten hot from the oven.
swaps: Use oat or soy milk for the plant milk. The vegan hard cheese can be omitted or replaced with a nut-free vegan parmesan (check label).
watch: Many vegan cheeses are cashew/almond-based; read the label or skip it.

title: Gluten-Free Baguette
description: A crackly-crusted, airy-crumbed French loaf made from white rice flour, starches and whole psyllium husk. Weekend project that pays off with real bakery-style slices.
swaps: Skip the optional egg-white wash; brush with water or oil instead for shine.
watch: Built from individual flours (white rice, tapioca, potato starch, psyllium), no blend needed.

title: Gluten Free Pumpkin Muffins (Dairy Free, Eggless)
description: Tender, warmly spiced pumpkin muffins made with buckwheat and brown rice flours and a brown-sugar crunch on top. Egg-free by design.
swaps: Leave out the pecans or swap pumpkin seeds. Use buckwheat flour (not the almond-flour option) and rice, soy or oat milk.
watch: Recipe lists almond flour and nuts as alternatives/mix-ins: stick to buckwheat flour and skip pecans.

title: Red Lentil Bread (Vegan & Gluten-Free)
description: A flourless, high-protein sandwich loaf made from soaked and blended red lentils, bound with psyllium and topped with seeds. Toasts beautifully.
watch: Use whole/ground psyllium husk (not a fiber supplement with additives).

title: Authentic Venezuelan Arepas
description: Crisp-on-the-outside, steamy-in-the-middle corn cakes made from just pre-cooked corn flour, water and salt. Split and stuff with black beans, avocado or shredded meat.
watch: Use Harina P.A.N. or another pre-cooked corn flour labelled gluten-free.

title: Homemade Corn Tortillas
description: Three-ingredient masa tortillas pressed and griddled until they puff. Once you taste them fresh, store-bought won't cut it for taco night.
watch: Use masa harina labelled gluten-free (e.g., Maseca or Bob's Red Mill GF).

title: Arepa Salada (Dominican Savory Cornbread)
description: A dense, custardy Dominican cornbread cooked from cornmeal simmered in coconut milk and broth with parsley. No flour, no eggs, and a lovely crusty edge.
swaps: Replace the salted butter with a nut-free vegan butter or olive oil; use vegetable broth.
watch: Use cornmeal labelled gluten-free. Coconut milk is fine.

title: Homemade Salvadoran Pupusas
description: Thick masa cakes stuffed with black beans and peppers and griddled until crisp-spotted. Serve with tangy curtido and salsa roja for a full Salvadoran meal.
swaps: Use a nut-free vegan shred (e.g., Violife or Daiya) or skip the cheese and add extra beans.
watch: Check vegan cheese label for cashew/almond; use GF-labelled masa harina.

title: Gluten Free Flour Tortillas (Fold Without Cracking)
description: Soft, bendy, char-spotted 'flour' tortillas that hold a burrito without splitting, thanks to psyllium. Egg-free, nut-free and oat-free by design.
swaps: Use a nut-free vegan butter (Earth Balance, Country Crock Plant Butter avocado/olive); avoid cashew-based Miyoko's.
watch: Tested with the author's homemade blend (rice/sorghum/starches/psyllium) and Bob's Red Mill 1:1 (add 2 tsp psyllium powder with Bob's). Use Anthony's or NOW psyllium to avoid purple tint.

title: Gluten-Free Artisan Cinnamon Raisin Bread
description: A crusty, egg-free yeast loaf with a ribbon of cinnamon-brown sugar and plump raisins. Toast it and slather with dairy-free butter.
swaps: Use a nut-free vegan butter (Earth Balance, Country Crock Plant Butter avocado/olive); avoid cashew-based Miyoko's. (only 28 g butter in the swirl.)
watch: Tested only with the author's DIY blend (white/brown rice, sorghum, potato & tapioca starch); she says 1:1 blends like Bob's 1:1 or KA Measure for Measure don't work. Use whole psyllium husks.

title: Gluten Free Soft Pretzels
description: Chewy, mahogany-crusted German-style pretzels, dipped in a baking-soda bath and showered with coarse salt. Perfect with mustard.
swaps: Use plant-based butter in the dough (author's swap). Skip the egg wash and brush with melted vegan butter instead (author's suggestion; finish may differ slightly). Use a nut-free vegan butter (Earth Balance, Country Crock Plant Butter avocado/olive); avoid cashew-based Miyoko's.
watch: Tested with the author's gum-free homemade blend (rice, sorghum, starches, psyllium, no nuts); Cup4Cup reportedly needs less water.

title: Buckwheat Bagels (GF & Vegan)
description: Boiled-then-baked bagels with a chewy bite and nutty buckwheat flavour, finished with everything seasoning. Vegan from the start, no egg wash needed.
watch: Use light buckwheat flour (not dark) and whole psyllium husks.

title: Gluten-Free Slider Buns
description: Pillowy little sorghum-and-starch buns sized for sliders, pulled pork or lunchbox sandwiches. Double the size for full burger buns.
swaps: Use 2 flax eggs (author's option) and plant-based milk (oat or soy).
watch: Built from sorghum, tapioca and potato starch with psyllium and xanthan gum; no nut flours.

title: Gluten Free Artisan Boule (No Egg, Optional Vegan)
description: A round, crackle-crusted country loaf with an open, chewy crumb, made without eggs from millet, oat and tapioca with psyllium. The proper weekend-bread project.
swaps: Use non-dairy milk powder (author tested coconut milk powder). Swap oat flour for sorghum if you prefer to avoid oats.
watch: Oat flour must be certified GF. Use dried active yeast (not instant) and ground psyllium husk (not fine powder) as specified.

title: Gluten-Free Vegan Apple Cider Doughnuts
description: Cakey, fried apple-cider doughnuts rolled in cinnamon sugar, with flax standing in for eggs. Pure orchard-season nostalgia.
watch: Built from brown rice flour, potato and tapioca starch with xanthan gum (no blend needed).

title: Ground Flaxseed Crackers
description: Crisp, savoury crackers made from nothing more than ground flaxseed, water, garlic and rosemary. A grain-free snack for dips and cheese-free boards.

title: Annika's Irish Soda Bread
description: A rustic, raisin-studded soda bread from an allergy-family kitchen, made with a GF flour blend, egg replacer and soured rice milk. No yeast, no kneading.
swaps: Use a dairy-free stick margarine; flax egg (1 Tbsp ground flax + 3 Tbsp water) can stand in for the Ener-G mix.
watch: Author uses equal parts rice flour, tapioca starch and cornstarch as the blend. Check margarine is dairy-free (many contain whey).

title: Annika's Lemon Bread
description: A sunny, tender lemon loaf that's egg-, dairy- and nut-free, made with oil, rice milk and fresh lemon. Bake as mini loaves for gifting.
watch: Uses a generic GF flour blend plus xanthan gum; pick an almond-free blend. Uses Ener-G Egg Replacer.

title: Pumpkin Scones
description: Spiced pumpkin scones bound by pumpkin purée alone, with rice and sweet rice flours for a soft, cakey crumb. Big batch for brunch or the freezer.
watch: Uses white/brown rice flour, sweet rice flour and xanthan gum (no blend needed).

title: Gluten Free Vegan Monkey Bread
description: Pull-apart balls of yeasted dough rolled in cinnamon sugar and baked into a sticky, gooey ring. A top-allergen-free brunch showstopper.
swaps: Use water or oat/soy milk for the 'milk of choice'.
watch: Uses the author's linked GF all-purpose flour mix (confirm almond-free) plus palm shortening; choose sustainably sourced palm shortening.

title: Coconut Cream Cinnamon Coffee Cake (Gluten Free Vegan)
description: A tender coconut-cream cake under a thick cinnamon-sugar crumb, with applesauce in place of the egg. Easy one-pan brunch baking.
swaps: Use a nut-free vegan butter (Earth Balance, Country Crock Plant Butter avocado/olive); avoid cashew-based Miyoko's. Author also suggests palm shortening.
watch: Use the author's GF white blend or another almond-free blend plus guar/xanthan gum.

title: Vegan Gluten-Free Zucchini Muffins
description: Moist, lightly sweet muffins packed with shredded zucchini and banana, spiced with cinnamon. A sneaky veg win for breakfast or lunchboxes.
swaps: Use applesauce instead of the almond/peanut butter (author's nut-free option). Use oat or soy milk.
watch: GF flour blend unspecified; pick one without almond flour.
